candidates.author: Jordan Roy-Byrne
candidates.text:
4) Gold & Silver Daily Chart

You do not need to be a technical analyst to recognize the short-term trend is down.

A retest of the summer lows in precious metals is becoming increasingly likely.

Be advised, Gold is notorious for false breakdowns & false new lows.

candidates.author: Jordan Roy-Byrne
candidates.text:
3) Gold Volatility

Gold exploded higher in Q1, sending volatility indicators sharply higher.

Volatility spikes are followed by periods of compression and subdued volatility.

$GVZ has fallen to an 8-month low, while 40-week Bollinger Band Width has declined to an 18-month low.

candidates.author: Jordan Roy-Byrne
candidates.text:
2) Fed Rate Hike Cycle

Gold made key lows in 1999, 2004, 2016, and 2017, each around the start of Fed tightening.

When Gold weakens in advance of rate hikes, the first hike has often marked the low. The market tends to discount the tightening cycle before it actually begins.
